store_summary_quantiles_meta.rationale: Preserves the established system summary-quantile grid.

horizons_years_meta.rationale: System Current Thesis / Primary Optimization / Persistence horizons.

initial_growth.rationale: Independent operating-evidence calibration, not price-implied: Q2 AI-cloud revenue was $574.9M (+514% YoY); ARR was $3.0B at June-end (+56% QoQ from $1.9B); company disclosed >$40B customer commitments; roughly 70% of Q2 deals included prepayments covering 50-60% of associated capex; majority of Q2 deals were signed against late-2026 capacity and contribute primarily to 2027 revenue; company guidance targets 5 GW contracted power by YE2026 and >1 GW/year deployment from 2027. Mode remains 120% from v1.0; v1.0.1 widens tails to 40-220% because disclosed operating evidence supports very high growth but does not identify a single forecast CAGR.

long_run_growth_y8.rationale: Long-run AI-infrastructure growth after capacity expansion matures.

growth_half_life_years_meta.rationale: Hypergrowth decays over multiple commissioning cycles rather than one year.

latent_loading_meta.rationale: AI segment is strongly exposed to common demand/capacity drivers but retains company-specific execution risk.

initial_growth.rationale: Residual non-AI businesses are small and volatile; calibration prevents them from dominating enterprise value.

long_run_growth_y8.rationale: Mature residual-growth assumption for Avride/TripleTen/eliminations net.

growth_half_life_years_meta.rationale: Small residual segment mean-reverts faster than core AI cloud.

latent_loading_meta.rationale: Other businesses have lower exposure to the core AI common-growth factor.

Y1.rationale: Customer prepayments can keep OCF unusually high during the initial buildout; sharply below H1 2026 4.59x OCF/revenue.

Y2.rationale: Prepayment tail persists but normalizes as revenue base scales.

Y3.rationale: OCF becomes more operating-economics driven by Y3.

Y4.rationale: OCF margin continues normalization with scaled recurring AI-cloud revenue.

Y5.rationale: Mature-but-growth OCF margin; still benefits from advance customer economics.

Y1.rationale: K3 remains very capital intensive in Y1, but far below Q2 capex/revenue ~9.7x.

Y3.rationale: Transition to positive FCF is expected only after substantial capex normalization.

Y5.rationale: Mature expansion still consumes meaningful capex.

Y8.rationale: Long-run capital intensity remains above software-like models.

multiple.rationale: Y3 remains bridge-dependent because FCF normalization is still an execution assumption.
Aligned with NBIS Reverse Valuation terminal multiple range.
Fallback when a path fails to reach positive horizon FCF.

factor_correlations_meta.rationale: High growth/utilization is positively related to cash normalization; valuation remains only partly correlated.

default_loading_meta.rationale: Strong shared AI-infrastructure factors with material idiosyncratic site/funding execution risk.

annualized_sigma_meta.rationale: Young high-beta AI-infrastructure equity; path volatility used only for drawdown layer.

discount_rate_meta.rationale: Inherited from NBIS Reverse Valuation calibration base case.

perturbations_meta.formula: local robustness v1.1.2: sigma_equiv=(Q84-Q16)/2; growth sigma=base-revenue-weighted RMS of segment initial_growth sigma_equiv; margin sigma=Y5 margin sigma_equiv (or sqrt(ocf^2+capex^2) for decomposition); multiple sigma=log-space sigma_equiv of Y5 multiple; local shift=0.25*sigma with ceilings 10pp growth, 5pp margin, 20% multiple; correlation remains ±0.15

persistence_meta.rationale: Site commissioning, contract conversion and capital deployment execution persist across adjacent quarters.
